title: Flashing
note: devlab flash did its first real flash (2026-11-10): the pristine stock image, the manifest's fixes baked in, the device tree fingerprinted (a43d069d0a49adcd), the phone back with all 20 checks passing.

title: Health, after every boot
note: devlab test, health, watch: regressions raise one board task.

title: The lab's ear
note: devlab hear and devlab health --hear work: a tone on each channel, recorded through the lab's microphone, measured against the silent room; heard checks join the one baseline when listened for. Its first results on surya were withdrawn - the microphone was being worn. It counts when the microphone has been placed by the phone, on notice.

title: devlab hear asks for the word first
note: devlab hear and devlab health --hear refuse without --placed, and say the procedure: tell the microphone's keeper, wait for their word. The lab's microphone can stay named: nothing plays by accident.

title: The microphone, placed on notice
note: The microphone can be relied on when it is placed by the phone. Before any listening test the agent notifies its keeper and waits for his word; only then is the test run, with --placed, and counted. The tool refuses otherwise.

title: The phone's own microphone, heard the same way
note: The lab plays a tone, the phone records it: the instrument for the long-open microphone work. And a second lab microphone, to tell left from right.

title: Listening by itself, at decent hours
note: The watcher stays silent: a tone after every start could sound at night. For it to listen unasked the lab needs to say when sound is welcome.

title: Safe test kernels
note: devlab kernel: one try by boot counting, a timeout that falls back to stock.

title: Half-manual tests
note: Sequential tests with an observer - a person now, a rig later.

title: Reaches the phone
note: devlab phone: USB or Wi-Fi, no quoting layer, boot ids.

title: Built on postmarketOS's conventions
note: device.toml from deviceinfo; tests in the shape of pmOS's initramfs CI; bootrr.

title: Provisioning
note: Packages, files by {compatible}, Wi-Fi; the shared connection undone by a guard. It sets a fresh phone's clock and grows its system to fill its partition first.

title: A proper rig
note: Asked for by the author, for the future: a microphone fixed in place, a webcam that sees the screen, servos that press the buttons and touch the glass - so the tests that need a hand, an eye or an ear can run by themselves, for any phone.
